economy.summary: Her campaign describes her as a fierce advocate for paid family leave and says the House under her leadership invested in workforce development and child care programs, framing care for workers and their families as the first step to rebuilding the economy.
economy.short: Advocates paid family leave; backs workforce development and child care.

taxes.summary: In a February 2026 statement on the governor's budget proposal, she said House Democrats have delivered for Pennsylvanians by cutting taxes for families and backed continued investments in the budget.
taxes.short: Says Democrats delivered for Pennsylvanians by cutting taxes for families.

abortion.summary: As a legislator she has consistently voted against bills restricting abortion, including a 2022 vote against a proposed constitutional amendment declaring there is no state constitutional right to abortion; she has been endorsed by Planned Parenthood.
abortion.short: Voted against abortion restrictions; endorsed by Planned Parenthood.

education.summary: Her campaign says she has championed universal pre-kindergarten and after-school enrichment programs and worked to secure fair funding for public schools across the commonwealth.
education.short: Championed universal pre-K; worked to secure fair public-school funding.

guns.summary: As Speaker she backed a House gun-safety package sent to the Senate, including H.B. 714 to expand background checks on firearm sales and H.B. 1018 red-flag legislation, and called on the Senate to act on the measures.
guns.short: Backed background-check and red-flag bills; urged Senate to act.
